latest_release.name: Encrypted channel tokens, connect links, Amazon SES & 40+ fixes
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

This release brings **encryption of the channel tokens in the database** (opt-in, with a local key or AWS KMS), **connect links** so the public API or an MCP agent can hand someone a link that adds a channel to your workspace, **Amazon SES** as an email provider, and a **channel checklist in the save and delete dialogs** of multi-channel posts. Instagram carousels go up to 20 items and send alt text, and a sweep of billing and provider fixes removes false "may have already published" warnings, duplicate reconnect notifications and several silent billing dead ends.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains two access-control fixes (billing routes, and post saves across organizations), all users are recommended to upgrade. It also changes the Prisma schema (new indexes only) and adds optional environment variables. No existing Temporal workflow version changed, one new workflow was added. See [Upgrade notes](#upgrade-notes).

## 🔒 Security

- **Billing routes require an organization admin** — only the invoices route checked the role, so a plain member could call the others directly (cancel, change the plan, end the trial, request a refund). They now answer 402 with "Only an admin of this organization can do this." (#2421)
- **Post saves are scoped to the organization** — a save that carries post or group ids of another organization is refused with a 404 instead of being applied (#2422)
- **Channel tokens can be encrypted at rest**, see below (#2430)

## ✨ Features

### Token encryption
- **Channel tokens encrypted in the database** — with `ENCRYPTION_PROVIDER` set, the access and refresh tokens of every channel are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). Two providers: `local` (the key in `ENCRYPTION_KEY`) and `aws-kms` (a data key that KMS decrypts once at start). Off by default, and nothing changes without it (#2430)
- No migration needed: plain and encrypted tokens work side by side, and a plain token is encrypted the next time it is refreshed
- New `encryptTokensWorkflow` encrypts the tokens that were stored before, started by hand from the Temporal UI or CLI
- `ENCRYPTION_READ_ONLY` for rollouts where the backend and the orchestrator do not restart at the same moment
- Orchestrator activities decrypt the tokens of a channel they receive from a workflow, the groundwork for keeping tokens out of the Temporal history (#2433)

### Public API / MCP
- **Connect links** — `POST /public/v1/integrations/connect` returns a link, valid for one hour, to a Postiz page where a person (with or without a Postiz account) reads what connecting the channel means and continues to the platform to approve the access. An optional `redirectUrl` sends them back to your app afterwards
- New MCP tool **`integrationConnectTool`**, so an agent can give the user a link to connect a new channel
- Connect links cover the platforms that connect with a plain redirect; platforms that need an API key, an instance URL, a wallet or the browser extension are still added from the dashboard. The channel limit of the plan is checked before the person is sent to the platform

### Email
- **Amazon SES** — `EMAIL_PROVIDER="ses"` with `SES_REGION`, using `SES_ACCESS_KEY` / `SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` or the default AWS credential chain
- Emails carry a `List-Unsubscribe` header that opens the account settings, where email notifications can be turned off (Resend, SES and Nodemailer)
- **Billing emails:** the cancellation email goes to the customer instead of the internal address, and a new set-to-cancel email states the exact end date (#2393, #2394)

### App
- **Choose channels in the save and delete dialogs** — for a post created for several channels, Delete, Post now, Update / Schedule and Save as draft list the channels with a checkbox each, instead of "all channels / only this channel" (#2422)
- **Instagram:** carousels of up to 20 media items (#2408), and media alt text is sent as `alt_text` on image containers (#2355)
- **YouTube:** the official YouTube icon is u
